items.title: Introducing OpenAI for Government
items.summary: We’re launching OpenAI for Government, a new initiative focused on bringing our most advanced AI tools to public servants across the United States. We’re supporting the U.S. government's efforts in adopting best-in-class technology and deploying these tools in service of the public good.
